limitations: Focused automated browser testing is not exhaustive security testing or WCAG conformance certification.
Axe incomplete findings are recorded for manual review rather than silently counted as passes.
SVG-backed and overlapped text needs visual inspection beyond computed solid-background contrast.
Native constraint validation tests confirm rejected UI submissions; separate Python regressions cover additional server-side validation.
overallAssessment: All normal functional and layout checks passed; one moderate accessibility best-practice finding and 11 incomplete contrast-rule instances remain documented. No app code or fixes changed.

observations: Product category captions and numerical indices occupy clear outer margins of the reviewed local SVG illustrations; no text-over-object collision was observed in the desktop catalogue.
Home collection index and desktop authentication art label appear against uncluttered pale backgrounds in the reviewed screenshots.
The open mobile navigation is opaque; it covers the introductory story text while its own navigation links remain readable. Escape closes it and restores button focus.
Cart summary, product editor and the separate framing fixture display readable text and intact layouts in the reviewed screenshots.
manualVisualReview.status: Focused visual inspection found no caption collision or visible contrast defect in these screenshots. Automated incomplete checks remain recorded as incomplete; this is not a complete accessibility or pixel-level contrast certification.
